evidence.title: Acebuilder - AI Landing Page Builder Powered by Aceternity UI

name: Acebuilder
summary: AI landing page builder on Aceternity UI: describe a page, generate it from React and Tailwind templates and blocks, then export the source.
description: Conversational landing page builder by the Aceternity UI team: pull in Aceternity UI Pro templates, complete pages and section blocks (heroes, features, pricing, testimonials, FAQs, CTAs), reshape copy and layout in chat, or run skills that push back on generic output. Generates production-grade React and Tailwind code in a Next.js project and exports the full source with no lock-in. Free to start; Pro $25, Business $50 and Studio $129 monthly plans add credits, projects and Aceternity UI Pro access.
contains: 7 showcase demos including Aceternity Features Grid, dashboard, 3D and cursor hero
blocks: heroes, features, pricing, testimonials, FAQs, CTAs
templates and pages from Aceternity UI Pro, editable in chat
skills that push back on generic output and sharpen layout and copy
exports full Next.js/React and Tailwind source; no proprietary export format
free to start; Pro $25/mo, Business $50/mo, Studio $129/mo with credits and projects
docs, blog and showcase alongside the builder
